name: flutter-reference
description: Reference-count CodeLens above Dart/Flutter declarations, plus a workspace scan for unused files, assets, and pubspec dependencies.

flutterReference.enabled.description: Show reference count CodeLens for Dart symbols.

flutterReference.filterDocComments.description: When true, references that live on a `///` documentation-comment line (e.g. `/// See [build]`) are not counted. Off by default.

flutterReference.excludePackages.description: Package names whose references are never counted. Defaults exclude the Flutter framework so overrides like build/initState don't get inflated counts from framework callbacks. Use the special value "all" to exclude every package outside your workspace lib/.

commands.title: Flutter Reference: Find Unused Files, Assets & Dependencies
